keyword: where is the final four this year
claims: The 2026 NCAA Men's Final Four is being held at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana.
The semifinals of the 2026 NCAA Men's Final Four are on Saturday, April 4, 2026.
The championship game of the 2026 NCAA Men's Final Four is on Monday, April 6, 2026.
The teams playing in the 2026 NCAA Men's Final Four are UConn, Illinois, Arizona, and Michigan.
The 2026 NCAA Men's Final Four features Arizona vs. Michigan and UConn vs. Illinois.
The 2026 NCAA Men's Final Four marks the fourth time Indianapolis has hosted the Final Four in the Lucas Oil Stadium era.
The 2026 Women's Final Four is being held in Phoenix, Arizona.
